Send crash reports
When Bridgit crashes or freezes, it sends the error, app version and phone model to Sentry. Never photos, screenshots, keys, your location or what agents asked.

Send feature-use tallies
Once a day, Bridgit sends bridgit.cc a count of which features were used. Only the counts: no install or device id, no agent names, no times, nothing agents sent or received.
